body.purpose: Hints and explanatory copy; the user's line runs at 1.125rem, controls and notices at 1rem.

components.name: Ghost Pill Button
components.description: Mute and camera controls during a call: transparent hairline pill, steel-plate fill on hover.

components.name: Toggled-off Pill
components.description: A mute or camera control whose device is off inverts to a sand fill (aria-pressed=true).
components.css: .ds-ctl-off { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid var(--steel-line, #3a4955); border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out; background: var(--sand, #eae3d2); border-color: var(--sand, #eae3d2); color: var(--steel, #1e2a33); } .ds-ctl-off:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-ctl-off:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sand, #eae3d2); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Start Call Button
components.description: The only primary action outside a call: sand-filled pill, weight 600.
components.css: .ds-ctl-start { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid var(--steel-line, #3a4955); border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out; padding: 0 28px; background: var(--sand, #eae3d2); border-color: var(--sand, #eae3d2); color: var(--steel, #1e2a33); font-weight: 600; } .ds-ctl-start:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-ctl-start:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sand, #eae3d2); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Hang Up Button
components.description: Ends the call; coral is reserved for this and for errors.
components.css: .ds-ctl-end { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid var(--steel-line, #3a4955); border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out; background: var(--coral, #e46f5a); border-color: var(--coral, #e46f5a); color: var(--steel, #1e2a33); font-weight: 600; } .ds-ctl-end:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-ctl-end:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sand, #eae3d2); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Voice Select
components.description: Native select styled as a ghost pill with a dim-sand chevron.
components.html: <label class="ds-voice"><select aria-label="Voz de krat"><option>Femenina · español</option><option>Masculina · español</option></select><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg></label>
components.css: .ds-voice { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; } .ds-voice select { appearance: none; height: 48px; padding: 0 44px 0 20px; border: 1px solid var(--steel-line, #3a4955); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--sand, #eae3d2); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-voice select:hover { background: var(--steel-plate, #27343e); } .ds-voice select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sand, #eae3d2); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-voice option { background: var(--steel, #1e2a33); color: var(--sand, #eae3d2); } .ds-voice svg { position: absolute; right: 18px; pointer-events: none; color: var(--sand-dim, #a9a597); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Live call state with a colour-coded dot and tabular elapsed seconds; brass dot = listening.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin: 0; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--steel-line, #3a4955); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--sand, #eae3d2); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--brass, #c9a44c); }

components.name: Chladni Plate
components.description: Signature element: sand grains on the steel plate, settled on the nodal lines of the idle (1,3,-) mode. Live, it is a canvas animated per call state.
components.css: .ds-plate { width: 240px; aspect-ratio: 1; padding: 12px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--steel-plate, #27343e); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--steel-line, #3a4955); } .ds-plate svg { display: block; }

components.name: Captions
components.description: Your line small and dim with a brass prefix; krat's reply large in sand.
components.html:
Tú: Hola, ¿qué tengo en la mano?

Tienes una silueta de un avión volando en el cielo azul.
components.css: .ds-captions { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; max-width: 62ch; text-align: center; color: var(--sand, #eae3d2); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-captions p { margin: 0; } .ds-you { color: var(--sand-dim, #a9a597); font-size: 1.125rem; } .ds-you span { color: var(--brass, #c9a44c); } .ds-reply { font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 2.2vw, 1.875rem); line-height: 1.35; text-wrap: pretty; }

components.name: Self-view Frame
components.description: Mirrored webcam frame; camera-off state shows an icon and a dim-sand caption.
components.css: .ds-cam { position: relative; width: 300px; aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; margin: 0; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--steel-plate, #27343e); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--steel-line, #3a4955); } .ds-cam figcaption { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px; color: var(--sand-dim, #a9a597); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; }

narrative.overview:
krat has no face. Its voice is shown as a Chladni figure: grains of sand on a square steel plate gather on the still nodal lines of whatever mode the plate is driven at. Each call state gets its own figure. While krat thinks or speaks, the figures cycle and the grains move with the live audio. Everything else on the screen is cut from the same material: a blued-steel ground, sand-colored type and particles, hairline steel edges. The dark ground comes from the material itself, a dark plate under light sand. It was not chosen because "call apps are dark".

There is one screen, and it is calm and sparse. The plate is the protagonist, centered and up to 520px square. The status chip, captions and pill controls stay quiet so the plate and the conversation carry the screen. Colour is rationed by meaning. Sand is the default ink. Brass appears only when krat is listening to you or showing your words. Coral appears only on hang up and on errors. The system deliberately refuses the category default, a glowing gradient orb over round icon buttons: no glow, no gradients and no drop shadows anywhere.

Type is set in Atkinson Hyperlegible Next at two weights, sized so captions can be read from arm's length while the person talks. krat's reply is the largest live text on screen. Your own words sit above it, smaller and dimmer.
keyCharacteristics: A square steel plate with a sand particle field is the single signature element and the agent's only visual identity.
The ground is blued steel and sand is the ink. Every colour comes from that physical palette.
Accent colours carry meaning: brass means "you / listening", coral means "end / error". Neither is used for decoration.
Depth is a single 1px inset steel hairline. Nothing casts a shadow.
Controls are hairline steel pills. Only primary actions are filled.

rules.name: The Brass Is You Rule
rules.body: Brass appears only when krat is listening to you or is quoting you: the listening/hearing dot, the "Tú:" prefix, and the hearing-state particles. Never use it for focus, selection, links, hover or decoration. Focus rings, selection, caret and `accent-color` are all sand.

rules.name: The Coral Ends Things Rule
rules.body: Coral is used only for hang up, error notices and the offline dot. A coral element on screen means "this stops the call" or "something went wrong", nothing else.

rules.name: The Material Palette Rule
rules.body: Every colour is a material from the plate world: steel, sand, brass fittings, and a warning paint. Do not introduce a colour that has no place in that world.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Only 400 and 600 are loaded, so only 400 and 600 may be used. 600 is reserved for the wordmark, the idle heading and the filled Start and Hang up pills.

rules.name: The Reply Outranks You Rule
rules.body: krat's reply is always larger and brighter than your transcribed line. You read what krat said, and only glance at what you said.

rules.name: The One Hairline Rule
rules.body: Depth comes only from a lighter steel surface plus the 1px inset hairline. Never use drop shadows, glows, blur or gradients for depth.

dos: **Do** let the plate be the only representation of krat. Express new agent states as new plate modes and drive levels.
**Do** use sand for every focus ring, selection, caret and `accent-color` (2px outline, 3px offset).
**Do** keep brass to "listening / you" and coral to hang up, errors and offline.
**Do** build new controls as 48px hairline pills in steel line, filled only when they start or end something or show a toggled-off state.
**Do** use the 1px inset hairline on a steel-plate surface for anything that must read as an object on the ground.
**Do** show elapsed time or latency in the status chip with tabular figures whenever krat is busy.
**Do** keep icon-only controls' labels in the DOM as screen-reader text.
donts: **Don't** use drop shadows, glows, gradients or blur anywhere.
**Don't** replace or decorate the plate with an orb, an avatar or a face.
**Don't** use brass for focus, links, hover or decoration, or coral for anything that isn't ending or failing.
**Don't** load or use any weight other than 400 and 600.
**Don't** add a light theme by inverting tokens. The dark ground comes from the steel plate and its sand, not from a theme toggle.
**Don't** introduce colours outside the steel, sand, brass and coral palette.
